skills.name: ux-accessibility
skills.description: Diagnose and fix accessible UI issues: keyboard/focus, labels, screen readers, contrast, pointer targets, reflow, motion and WCAG compliance checks.

skills.name: ux-build
skills.description: Design, implement, or refactor frontend UI/UX flows, components, forms, dashboards, and interactions with evidence-based usability patterns. Use during actual UI creation or UX fixes, not only after a review.

skills.name: ux-controls-and-inputs
skills.description: Fix UI target-size, mis-tap, button placement, keyboard-control, interaction-state, and pointer affordance problems using Fitts’s Law and accessible control semantics.

skills.name: ux-decisions-and-load
skills.description: Fix overwhelming menus, cognitive overload, too many choices, poor chunking, hidden context, recall-heavy workflows, or misplaced complexity in UI design and implementation.

skills.name: ux-diagnose
skills.description: Classify observed UI/UX problems into actionable root-cause categories, identify relevant Laws of UX, and route to remediation. Use for vague usability complaints, confusing screens, screenshots, UX debugging, or when unsure which UX skill applies.

skills.name: ux-feedback-and-performance
skills.description: Fix slow-feeling UI, missing loading acknowledgement, stale or optimistic success messages, unclear progress, duplicate submissions, and async state feedback.

skills.name: ux-forms-and-errors
skills.description: Fix form usability, validation, ambiguous input, repeated entry, bad defaults, inline error messages, draft loss and recovery; design robust but secure user inputs.

skills.name: ux-journeys-and-motivation
skills.description: Improve multi-step journeys, near-end abandonment, interrupted tasks, emotionally stressful interactions, bad completion states and task flow while preserving user autonomy.

skills.name: ux-navigation-and-structure
skills.description: Fix confusing navigation, poor information architecture, unexpected labels, mental-model mismatch, redesign unfamiliarity, and difficult-to-find features in user interfaces.

skills.name: ux-onboarding-and-learning
skills.description: Fix forced product tours, poor novice discoverability, confusing first-run screens, progressive onboarding and contextual assistance without blocking users’ first tasks.

skills.name: ux-review
skills.description: Review or audit existing user interfaces, UX journeys, screenshots, prototypes, or code for usability issues; produce evidence-graded, prioritized findings linked to Laws of UX and testable remediation.

skills.name: ux-trust-and-ethics
skills.description: Review or repair deceptive UX, manipulative defaults, scarcity cues, trust breakdowns, unclear consent, hidden costs, persuasive design and aesthetic overconfidence.

skills.name: ux-validate
skills.description: Validate a designed or implemented UI/UX change with task-based usability checks, accessibility checks, keyboard/mobile flows, failure recovery, and explicit evidence. Use for verifying fixes and UI acceptance tests.

skills.name: ux-visual-hierarchy
skills.description: Fix weak visual hierarchy, misleading grouping, unclear affordances, excessive cards, competing emphasis, scannability failures, and icon ambiguity in UI.

skills.name: wcag21-alternatives-and-media
skills.description: Fix WCAG 2.1 image text alternatives, complex graphics, captions, audio description, prerecorded/live media and sign-language accessibility. Use when content cannot be perceived without vision or hearing.

skills.name: wcag21-assistive-tech-and-status
skills.description: Fix WCAG 2.1 accessible names, roles, values, control states and dynamic live status messages; interpret the updated 4.1.1 Parsing note. Use for ARIA, assistive technology and async UI defects.

skills.name: wcag21-build
skills.description: Implement accessible web UI components and flows against WCAG 2.1 A/AA/AAA requirements. Use while coding forms, dialogs, navigation, menus, responsive layouts, media, live regions, keyboard behavior or design-system components.

skills.name: wcag21-diagnose
skills.description: Classify accessibility defects and user barriers against WCAG 2.1 success criteria and route to specialist repair skills. Use for a11y complaints, screenshots, inaccessible UI, keyboard/screen reader failures, or unclear compliance criteria.

skills.name: wcag21-forms-and-error-prevention
skills.description: Fix WCAG 2.1 input purpose/autocomplete, form labels, visible error text, correction suggestions, safe submission confirmation and help. Use for accessible form building and error recovery.

skills.name: wcag21-keyboard-and-focus
skills.description: Fix WCAG 2.1 keyboard parity, traps, focus order and visibility, single-character shortcuts, dialogs and custom widget keys. Use for keyboard-only failures and inaccessible focus behavior.

skills.name: wcag21-language-and-predictability
skills.description: Fix WCAG 2.1 language metadata, embedded foreign phrases, jargon and abbreviations, reading comprehension, consistent navigation and unexpected context changes. Use for language or predictability issues.

skills.name: wcag21-navigation-and-discovery
skills.description: Fix WCAG 2.1 bypass links, route/page titles, link purpose, multiple ways to find pages, heading labels and location cues. Use for accessibility navigation and orientation problems.

skills.name: wcag21-pointer-and-touch
skills.description: Fix WCAG 2.1 touch/gesture alternatives, pointer cancellation, voice-visible label matching, motion activation, AAA 44px targets and concurrent inputs. Use for mobile and pointer access problems.

skills.name: wcag21-review
skills.description: Perform an evidence-based WCAG 2.1 accessibility audit of web pages, applications, components and end-to-end flows. Use for A/AA/AAA reviews, PR audits, acceptance criteria, accessibility checklists and compliance gap analyses.

skills.name: wcag21-semantics-and-reading-order
skills.description: Fix WCAG 2.1 semantic HTML, headings, relationships, data tables, meaningful reading order and non-sensory instructions. Use for screen reader structure and DOM ordering defects.

skills.name: wcag21-time-and-motion
skills.description: Fix WCAG 2.1 time limits, session extension, timeout data preservation, autoplay, moving content, flashing safety and reduced-motion. Use for timers, unexpected interruptions and animation barriers.

skills.name: wcag21-validate
skills.description: Validate WCAG 2.1 fixes and audit evidence with automation plus keyboard, visual, assistive technology and end-to-end process tests. Use for regression testing, release gates, accessibility sign-off and checking whether an audit result supports an A/AA/AAA claim.

skills.name: wcag21-visual-and-responsive
skills.description: Fix WCAG 2.1 contrast, color-only meaning, 200% text resize, 320px reflow, text-spacing overrides, orientation and hover/focus popovers. Use for visual and responsive accessibility defects.
